description_en: Visitors of the Karuṇācuka Bahī, a branch of Yampi Bahī, find it at the crossroad of Gãchẽ and Bangalamukhi on the way to Sankhamūla and   accessed it through an entrance on the western wing of the main monastic building. The Bahī shows a small blind window on the right side of the door and a small wooden railed window on the left. The constructors of the building complex raised it on a platform. The main sanctum is located in the east and people can enterit through a iron channel gate. The gate depicts on its both sides  a wall painting showing two monks. Within the main sanctum stands a statue of Akṣobhya Buddha facing west.The first floor of the west elevation contains newly installed vertical windows, while the windows of the second floor are irregularly placed and differently sized. Only the main door and one blind window survived in the original shape. Proceeding from the plan door that leads to the courtyard of the Bahī one finds aphalcāon either side of the entrance. Entering the monastery through these colonnadedphalcās, one sees aśikharakūṭacaityaat the centre of a sunken courtyard, measuring 9.7 x 10 m. Ajaladroṇi(jahrũ), placed in front of thecaityaon the wetsern side shows  a Licchavi inscription. Next to them are threemandaḥpāḥsrepresenting Harisiddhi, Lokeśvara and Bhairava. The courtyard is surrounded by A row of columns surrounds the courtyard on three sides (S, W, E), while the northern side has a narrow passage that leads to Yampī Bahī. There is a window above the main door of the first floor. The roof of the monastery is tiled. The colonnaded spaces have been filled in with haphazard brick walls to create spaces for residential purposes. The first floor area has also been also altered through the addition of differently sized windows and partition walls.
description_ne: यो यम्पि महाविहारको शाखा विहार हो । यो विहार यम्पि महाविहारसँगै दक्षिणपट्टि टाँस्सिएर रहेको छ । यो बही निकै साधारण देखिन्छ । विहारभित्र पस्ने मूलद्वारमा कुनै कलाकृति बनाइएको छैन । मूलद्वारको ठीक अगाडि साधारण गन्धकुटी बनाइएको छ । गन्धकुटीभित्र पश्चिमाभिमुख गरी भूमिस्पर्श मुद्रामा अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध स्थापना गरिएको छ । विहार परिसरमा एउटा शिखरकूट चैत्य र लिच्छविलिपि अंकित जलद्रोणी रहेको छ । भुइँमा हरिसिद्धि, लोकेश्वर र भैरवको प्रतीक स्वरूप तीनवटा मन्द:पा: बनाइएका छन् ।रातो मच्छिन्द्रनाथको मूर्ति यसै विहारमा बनाइएको जनधारणा छ । पद्मसम्भवसँग सम्बन्धित रहेको विहार हुनाले तिब्बतीहरू निकै श्रद्धा राखी यो विहार दर्शन गर्न आउँछन् ।
